bio: This establishment draws the eye with its refined decor as much as it appeals with its two mouth-watering set menus: the weekly lunch menu (Inspiration de la Semaine – three to five courses) and the evening menu (Éclosion des Sens – three to seven courses), which is changed every month. Diners enjoy modern seasonal cuisine with a dash of creative flair, which keeps them coming back for more. A food and wine pairing event is also organised one evening a month....
